item.title: Finalists chosen for next Bakersfield chief of police
item.description: Bakersfield Police Chief Greg Terry announced his retirement in April. After a handful of community input sessions and interviews with close to a dozen candidates, the city and the police department is one huge step closer to picking its next top officer.
